title: Deligne–Laumon: Reduction to the Affine Line
text:
content: the formal reductions from general compact-support direct images
to the affine-line estimate of Section [sec-deligne-laumon-a1].  
key results: [sk-thm-dl-general-sheaf] and [sk-cor-dl-general-complex].  
references: [`weil_conjectures_complete_notes.pdf`](run:weil_conjectures_complete_notes.pdf),
§12.2, Lemmas 12.2–12.5; completion in §§12.3–12.6.
